terra.problem: “The wall celebration ends here” is misleading. The choir went as far as the Sheep Gate but stopped at the Gate of the Guard, and the choirs then stood in the house of God (Nehemiah 12:39–40).
Nehemiah 12:39 alone does not say that Nehemiah and half the people followed the choir along the top of the wall. Include verse 38 in the passage.
Jesus’ encounter with the man happened at the pool of Bethesda, which was near the Sheep Gate, not at the gate itself.
“Invalid” may be unfamiliar to fifth-grade readers. “A man who had been sick for thirty-eight years” is simpler.
